result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane urban intersection with significant deficiencies in pedestrian infrastructure. While sidewalks are present, there are no visible marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, or refuge islands to facilitate safe crossing of the wide roadway.

hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross a very wide, multi-lane roadway without any mid-block refuge or marked path.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: The intersection lacks marked crosswalks and pedestrian signal heads, making pedestrian movements unpredictable to drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear right-of-way information.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane intersection in a mixed-use urban area with significant deficiencies in pedestrian infrastructure. While sidewalks are present, there are no marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, or curb ramps visible at this wide crossing, forcing pedestrians to navigate traffic without dedicated protection.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no painted markings to define a safe path for pedestrians or to alert drivers to expect people crossing.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide, undivided roadway creates a long exposure time for pedestrians without any refuge islands.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a median refuge island to break up the long crossing distance and allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: ADA Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps at all crossing points.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Add countdown pedestrian signals to the existing traffic light infrastructure to provide clear timing for crossings.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized intersection with wide sidewalks but significant deficiencies in pedestrian crossing infrastructure. result.summary: The image shows an urban intersection with mixed-use buildings and narrow sidewalks. While sidewalks are present, the environment lacks high-visibility pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or dedicated signals at the immediate crossing point.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no painted markings to indicate a pedestrian crossing area at the intersection, increasing the risk of vehicle-pedestrian conflict.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Cars parked close to the corner may obstruct the sight lines between drivers and pedestrians attempting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection near the corner store

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: The road surface shows significant cracking and wear, which can create tripping hazards or cause vehicles to swerve.

interventions.description: Install continental-style painted crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space and alert drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility by preventing parking too close to the intersection.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the intersection to improve sight lines for all road users.
